preconditions.description: Both s and t must be strings.
The lengths of both strings s and t must not exceed 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: Both strings s and t must consist only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(len({s[:i] + t[:j] for i in range(1, len(s) + 1) for j in range(1, len(t) + 1)}))
postconditions.description: The output must be the number of distinct strings formed by concatenating non-empty prefixes of s and t.
